tasks.title: Front matter parsing
tasks.objective: Implement split_front_matter(text: str) -> tuple[Optional[str], str] and parse_front_matter(text: str) -> dict[str, str] in src/slatepress/frontmatter.py. split_front_matter splits text separated by '---' delimiters, returning (front_matter_str, content_str), or (None, text) if no front matter exists. Raises ValueError when the opening '---' delimiter is present but never closed. parse_front_matter takes front matter text and returns a dict[str, str] supporting simple 'key: value' lines and ignoring comment lines beginning with '#'.
acceptance_criteria: split_front_matter successfully parses valid front matter
split_front_matter raises ValueError on unclosed front matter
parse_front_matter ignores # comments and parses key-value pairs

tasks.title: HTML templates and escaping
tasks.objective: Implement escape(text: str) -> str and page(title: str, body: str, css_link: Optional[str] = None) -> str in src/slatepress/html.py. escape encodes HTML special characters (&, <, >). page produces a complete HTML5 document string with doctype, head with title and optional css_link, and body containing a main element with the body argument.
acceptance_criteria: page generates valid HTML5 document structure

tasks.title: Markdown inline markup
tasks.objective: Implement inline_markup(text: str) -> str in src/slatepress/markdown.py. Applies bold with double asterisks (**text**), italic with single asterisks (*text*), and inline code with backticks (`text`). Must escape HTML special characters (&, <, >) FIRST so markup characters in source text are not treated as markup after escaping.
acceptance_criteria: inline_markup handles bold, italic, and inline code
HTML characters are escaped before markup parsing

tasks.title: Site builder
tasks.objective: Implement build_site(source_dir: Path, output_dir: Path) -> list[str] in src/slatepress/site.py. Converts Markdown files (.md) to HTML using front matter, markdown, and html modules, recursing into subdirectories, skipping any file whose name begins with an underscore or a dot, and copying any non-Markdown file unchanged. Returns a list of output file paths written as strings.
acceptance_criteria: build_site processes markdown files and copies others
skips files/dirs starting with underscore or dot

tasks.title: CLI interface
tasks.objective: Implement main(argv: list[str]) -> int in src/slatepress/cli.py. Takes a source directory and an optional output directory defaulting to a directory named _site. Returns 0 on success and 2 when the source directory does not exist.
acceptance_criteria: main returns 2 when source directory is missing
